Hanoi

Hanoi 4

  1. Must see · Vietnamese · Hanoi

    Bun Cha Huong Lien

    The 'Obama bun cha' where Barack Obama and Anthony Bourdain dined in 2016 (Parts Unknown); now in the MICHELIN Guide Vietnam.

    24 Le Van Huu Street, Hai Ba Trung District, Hanoi, Vietnam

    Recommended by MICHELIN Guide, Daniel Food Diary, VnExpress International

  2. Must see · Hanoi

    Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple & the Old Quarter

    Hanoi's civic heart — the legendary lake and its red bridge to Ngoc Son Temple, ringed by the 36-streets Old Quarter.

    Look for Lake, temple & old quarter

    Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

    Recommended by Lonely Planet, Wikipedia

  3. Must see · Hanoi

    Ha Long Bay

    The UNESCO seascape of thousands of limestone karst islands — Vietnam's iconic natural wonder.

    Look for UNESCO natural site

    Quang Ninh Province (day trip / cruise from Hanoi), Vietnam

    Recommended by UNESCO World Heritage, Wikipedia

  4. Must see · Vietnamese · Hanoi

    Pho Gia Truyen (Bat Dan)

    Hanoi's most famous old-school beef pho — order at the counter and queue; MICHELIN Bib Gourmand.

    49 Bat Dan Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

    Recommended by MICHELIN Guide — Bib Gourmand, Vietnam Coracle (Tom Divers)

2 sights and 2 places to eat in the city of Hanoi, each traceable to the source that named it (Michelin, local news & vetted local/viral creators). Renders in soft pastel, light or dark.

How this guide was made

Web-searched & fact-checked

Every place is traceable to a credible source — Michelin, UNESCO, local news & magazines, and vetted local/viral creators — in data/sources.json. Coordinates are verified into data/geocodes.json and every place status-checked open. Yelp/TripAdvisor never count toward the two-source bar.
